subject: How to synchronize color set for grouping and clustering in plots produced by dartR

messages.author: e128ae1057d75fd3
messages.subject: How to synchronize color set for grouping and clustering in plots produced by dartR
parts:
Hi,

I am struggling with the color settings that are not synchronized between groups/clusters in PCoA 2D, PCoA 3D, identity by descent produced by the gl.grm() function, distance matrix, plot STRUCTURE, and other clustering or grouping analysis in plots produced by dartR. Do you know how to set the colors so that every grouping colors are synchronized?

I would greatly appreciate it if you could provide a demonstration. Thank you in advance.

Regards,

Rizki

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: How to synchronize color set for grouping and clustering in plots produced by dartR
parts:
Hi Rizki,

Please find below some examples to synchronise colors across analyses.

Cheers,
Luis

########## USING SAME COLORS ACROSS ANALYSES #########
library(dartRverse)
t1 <- platypus.gl
#filtering
t1 <- gl.filter.callrate(t1,
                         threshold = 1)
t1 <- gl.filter.monomorphs(t1)
# select colors
pcolors <- gl.select.colors(library='baseR',
                            palette='rainbow',
                            ncolors = nPop(t1))
# PCA
pca <- gl.pcoa(t1)
# 2D plot
gl.pcoa.plot(glPca = pca,
             x = t1,
             pt.colors = pcolors)
# 3D plot
gl.pcoa.plot(glPca = pca,
             x = t1,
             pt.colors = pcolors,
             zaxis = 3)
# GRM
g1 <- gl.grm(x = t1,
       palette_convergent = gl.colors(type = "con"),
       palette_discrete = pcolors)
# network
gl.grm.network(G = g1,
               x = t1,
               palette_discrete = pcolors)
# location map
gl.map.interactive(x = t1,
                   ind.circle.cols = pcolors[as.numeric(pop(t1))])
# heterozygosity
gl.report.heterozygosity(x = t1,
                         plot.colors.pop = pcolors)
# spatial autocorrelation
gl.spatial.autoCorr(x = t1,
                    plot.colors.pop = pcolors)
# LD vs distance
# assigning chromosome and SNP position
t1$chromosome <- t1$other$loc.metrics$Chrom_Platypus_Chrom_NCBIv1
t1$position <- t1$other$loc.metrics$ChromPos_Platypus_Chrom_NCBIv1
l1 <- gl.report.ld.map(t1,
                       ld.max.pairwise = 1e7)
gl.ld.distance(ld.report = l1,
               pop.colors = pcolors)
# effective population size
gl.LDNe(x= t1,
        plot_colors_pop = pcolors)
